title: FormDescriptor
description: Describes a named create/edit form definition bound to one entity.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: a form is referenced by page `formName`, `createFormName`, or `editFormName`. Keep `entityName` aligned with the page entityName. Define all fields in `fields`, then place every visible field in `layout.tabs[].groups[].fields[]` by field id (each placement carries `row`, `colSpan`, and `colStart`). Use form `rules` for conditional visibility/enabled state; use entity validators for core data validation.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference used when this descriptor is stored as a model descriptor file.

name.description: Stable unique form identifier. Prefer kebab-case, for example 'customer-form' or 'event-form'. Pages reference this value.

entityName.description: Full name of the entity this form is bound to. Must match the page entityName that uses this form.

enableSaveAndNew.description: Whether the form should expose a Save and New action in addition to the standard save action. Useful for rapid data entry.

fields.description: Flat list of all fields in this form. Field ids must be unique within the form; bound fields should point to properties on entityName.

layout.description: Visual layout for the fields. Every layout placement fieldId must refer to a field in fields.

rules.description: Conditional rules for field/group visibility, enabled state, and value setting. Use for simple client-side form behavior.
